response.sql: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_count, AVG(examination_count * 1.0) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.examination_count) AS total_examination_count, AVG(sc.examination_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.examination_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE sc.examination_count > o.average_count

assumptions.assumption: The per-sex average includes SEX groups present among matched examination records; NULL and empty string remain separate groups.
